# User

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A user record. Writable profile fields update the current user immediately; snapshots remain read-only.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#the-caller-400).

A writable property still requires a writable handle: `Session.User` and `Board.FindUser()`/`Board.AddUser()` support changes; `Board.Users` entries are read-only snapshots. Changes are saved immediately.

## AddContact

```PPL
User.AddContact(STRING service, STRING account) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Adds or removes a contact on the current user and reports failures through `Error.Last()`.

## Alias

`User.Alias: STRING`

Writable instance property.

User profile or usage statistic. `Session.User` is live and writable where supported; entries from `Board.Users` are read-only snapshots.

## BirthDate

`User.BirthDate: DATE`

Writable instance property.

Native calendar birthday, without legacy year truncation. Writable on Session.User; empty values are rejected.

## ExpirationDate

`User.ExpirationDate: DATE`

Writable instance property.

Native calendar DATE from the UTC expiry timestamp. Writable on Session.User; assigning a nonempty date stores midnight UTC. Errors leave the value unchanged and update Error.Last(). Invalid users return empty.

## ExpiresAt

`User.ExpiresAt: TIMESTAMP`

Writable instance property.

Native UTC timestamp, retaining the precision of the backing data. Writable user expiry fields reject empty values. Invalid objects return empty.

## SetPassword

Instance function.
